verdict.rationale: Otter documents shared Channels for grouping meetings by team or project, SSO-based access control via Okta and Azure AD, and admin audit trails and activity logs that give some admin visibility into account activity. It does not claim private-by-default notes, and multiple community reports say transcripts and summaries are shared or emailed to all meeting participants by default, directly undercutting that part of the story. Missing for 10: private-by-default sharing, documented granular link/folder/workspace permission controls, admin visibility specifically into what content is shared, independent corroboration of the admin controls.
